KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kusikiliza kwa Kufasiri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Novela and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
